question: Which deities are addressed after enclosing with the armour-mantra?
premises: Enclosure is performed with the armour-mantra.
The rudras situated in the enclosure are then addressed.
inference: After enclosing with the armour-mantra, one should proceed to the rudras situated in the enclosure.
plain_english: Having enclosed with the armour-mantra, one should then proceed to the rudras situated in the enclosure.
